answer: The tide miller grinds only when the tide turns, and the miller chalks the sacks as the wheel slows. Respiratory therapist registration with health council attestation is the tide table's authority: three-year degree, 1,000 supervised treatments, exam, annual renewal. A sack ground under a false beacon comes up short when the flour is weighed, and the shortfall names the cheat. The gale is the forfeit, a month's grinding fees handed to the parish, while the reef is the tide book, kept beside the wheel and read at every audit.
